DISCOVERY 612, MOTION MTN TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSES TO DET'S DISCO REQUESTS -- DEFENDANT/MOVING PARTY MICHAEL HALL APPEARING IN PRO PER. DAVE MARCOLINI APPEARING FOR PLAINTIFF. ARGUED AND TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED: DEFENDANT'S MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSES TO DEFENDANT'S DISCOVERY REQUESTS IS GRANTED. PLAINTIFF'S OBJECTIONS ARE ORDERED STRICKEN. AS THE RESPONSES ASSERT THAT DISCOVERY IS CONTINUING, THOSE RESPONSES ARE ORDERED STRICKEN. THE RESPONSES MUST BE COMPLETE AT THE TIME THEY ARE MADE. AS TO THE RESPONSES TO THE DOCUMENT REQUESTS, THE RESPONSES MAY BE OTHERWISE SUFFICIENT. AS TO THE INTERROGATORIES, PLAINTIFF IS ORDERED TO SUPPLEMENT NO. 3. THE RESPONSE TO NO. 2, THE OBJECTIONS BEING STRICKEN, MAY BE OTHERWISE SUFFICIENT. FURTHER RESPONSES SHALL BE MADE WITHIN 10 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. DEFENDANT'S REQUEST FOR SANCTIONS IS DENIED. (612/EAHEWLETT)
